name: zcode-grokbot-dispatch
description: Grok Bot Dispatch for ZCode: bidirectional task dispatch between ZCode desktop and Grok Bot / DSH ([Project: X] routing, persistent session<->job mapping, automatic result reporting back to your Grok Bot peer: direct HTTP by default, Yobiru optional).
